entries.text: Your workspace stays mounted as you move between screens, preserving your place and ongoing work. Settings remains accessible while Articles load or when loading fails.

If an Author Skill change is interrupted, Settings shows its recovery status and offers a retry. Affected Skills stay unavailable until recovery succeeds, while Articles and built-in Skills remain available.
You can regenerate an Article title from the Library and clear current attention for an Article and its translations without resolving the underlying review work.
Saving work no longer has to wait for generated titles or Revision descriptions; that metadata can finish in the background.
When optional telemetry is enabled, successful Assistant and text generation work can report the configured provider and model identifiers separately.
Save and Load controls have clearer file action icons.
